title: Minecraft equipment definition
description: Defines textures used for equipment rendering layers.

layers.title: Layers
layers.description: Keys are equipment preset model types, such as humanoid, humanoid_leggings, wings, wolf_body, llama_body.

humanoid.description: Head, chest, and feet armor model for humanoid entities.

humanoid_leggings.description: Leg armor model for humanoid entities.

humanoid_baby.description: Armor model for baby humanoid entities.

wings.description: Wing model for players, player models, and armor stands.

horse_body.description: Body armor model for horses, skeleton horses, and zombie horses.

llama_body.description: Body armor model for llamas and trader llamas.

happy_ghast_body.description: Body armor model for happy ghasts.

nautilus_body.description: Body armor model for nautiluses and zombie nautiluses.

nautilus_saddle.description: Saddle model for nautiluses and zombie nautiluses.

texture.title: Texture
texture.description: Equipment layer texture path. Resolves to textures/entity/equipment/<layer>.

color_when_undyed.title: Undyed color
color_when_undyed.description: The decimal RGB color value used when undyed.

use_player_texture.title: Use player cape texture
use_player_texture.description: Available for the wings preset model. When true, uses the player's cape texture for wing rendering. Defaults to false.
